title: DocScrub-Web fixture manifest
description: Describes one golden-fixture case (architecture v0.2 §13). Each fixture case is a directory containing this manifest.json plus a source/ directory and an expected/ directory referenced by expectedFiles.

fixtureId.description: Directory-safe unique id for this fixture case, e.g. 'synthetic-transcript-001'.

family.description: Which of the three fixture families (architecture v0.2 §13.1-13.3) this case belongs to.

sourceDocument.description: Present for domain-parity and performance fixtures that are anchored to a source .docx. Interaction fixtures may omit this if they exercise pure UI state instead.

pythonAppBuild.description: The APP_BUILD string from local_web_app.py at the time this fixture was captured, so a fixture can be traced back to the exact Python behavior it recorded.

expectedFiles.description: Relative paths (from this manifest's directory) to the JSON files holding expected output, e.g. 'expected/candidates.json'.

performanceBudget.description: Required when family == 'performance' (architecture v0.2 §13.3). Explicit budgets rather than a vague 'large document' criterion.

interactionScenario.description: Required when family == 'interaction' (architecture v0.2 §13.2). Names the scripted keyboard/focus scenario this fixture exercises.

steps.description: Ordered, human-readable description of the command sequence dispatched, matching Commands.ts command names where possible.

deviations.description: Intentional, approved deviations from Python behavior for this case (architecture v0.2 §13: 'Intentional deviations must be approved and recorded rather than silently accepted.'). Empty array means none.
